=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text minus "-"
text trule "rule "
text tdot "."
text thash "#"
global cur uchar 32
global nxt uchar 32
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note 31 cells on a ring; a cell's next state is bit (4*left + 2*self + right) of the rule number
fn line to void
for i ulong 31
if eq get cur i 1
emit thash
else
emit tdot
end
end
emit nl
end
fn step rule ulong to void
for i ulong 31
l = ulong get cur rem add i 30 31
c = ulong get cur i
r = ulong get cur rem add i 1 31
k = add add mul l 4 mul c 2 r
put nxt i uchar and shr rule k 1
end
for i ulong 31
put cur i get nxt i
end
end
fn run rule ulong to void
emit trule
emitu rule
emit nl
for i ulong 31
put cur i 0
end
put cur 15 1
for g ulong 16
line
step rule
end
end
fn main to int
run 90
emit nl
run 30
emit nl
run 110
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
